args: d="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/buzz/claude-code"; [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && d="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Buzz/claude-code"; v="${BUZZ_CLAUDE_VERSION:-$(cat "$d/current" 2>/dev/null)}"; case "$v" in ""|[!0-9]*|*[!0-9.]*) echo "Claude is not installed" >&2; exit 127;; esac; exec "$d/$v/claude" "$@"

set -e; d="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/buzz/claude-code"; [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && d="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Buzz/claude-code"; case "$1" in ""|[!0-9]*|*[!0-9.]*) echo "Invalid version" >&2; exit 2;; esac; case "$2" in darwin-arm64|darwin-x64|linux-arm64|linux-x64) ;; *) echo "Unsupported platform" >&2; exit 2;; esac; f="$d/$1/claude"; mkdir -p "$d/$1"; curl -fsSL -o "$f.part" "https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases/$1/$2/claude"; s=$( (shasum -a 256 "$f.part" 2>/dev/null || sha256sum "$f.part") | cut -d" " -f1); [ "$s" = "$3" ] || { rm -f "$f.part"; echo "The download did not match its checksum" >&2; exit 1; }; chmod +x "$f.part"; mv -f "$f.part" "$f"

set -e; d="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/buzz/claude-code"; [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && d="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Buzz/claude-code"; case "$1" in ""|[!0-9]*|*[!0-9.]*) echo "Invalid version" >&2; exit 2;; esac; test -x "$d/$1/claude"; p=$(cat "$d/current" 2>/dev/null || true); printf %s "$1" > "$d/current.tmp"; mv -f "$d/current.tmp" "$d/current"; for o in "$d"/*/; do o=$(basename "$o"); [ "$o" = "$1" ] || [ "$o" = "$p" ] || rm -rf "${d:?}/$o"; done
